BL-0.1.4-004-S10.title: Internal Audit Query Interface
BL-0.1.4-004-S10.description: Implement internal-only query utilities for retrieving audit records by correlation_id, actor, and time range, including verification of hash chain integrity during read operations without exposing public API endpoints.

BL-0.1.4-004-S11.title: Audit Log Storage Structure and Indexing
BL-0.1.4-004-S11.description: Define MongoDB collection structure, indexing strategy (timestamp, correlation_id, actor), and write patterns to support efficient append-only storage and retrieval aligned with debug_logger persistence.

BL-0.1.4-004-S12.title: De-identification and Sensitive Data Handling in Audit Logs
BL-0.1.4-004-S12.description: Extend audit logging to enforce de-identification rules and sensitive data filtering consistent with existing debug_logger behavior, ensuring no PHI leakage while preserving forensic usefulness.
